text:
maria_cs: Hey team — I'm drafting a short customer-facing runbook for low-traffic accounts that often hit cold cache during renewal demos. Goal: simple steps CS can give customers to reduce latency spikes (prefill, lightweight batching, stream fallbacks) + a one-page checklist we can paste in an onboarding email. Can you quick-review ideas?

aj_support: Love this. A few quick suggestions: 1) include a one-click prefill curl snippet, 2) recommended prefill size (tokens/users), 3) guidance for toggling streaming vs non-streaming during demos.

maria_cs: Exactly. Thinking a short checklist at top (3 bullets) and then a tiny ops section with example calls. Draft below — please annotate.

maria_cs: CHECKLIST (top 60s):
- Prefill sample prompts (3) to warm model + KV cache
- Enable short-lived batch mode for demo minutes
- Use streaming fallback for interactive demos if tokens > 512

devon_psm: Add renewal-angle notes: remind customers that warm caches improve perceived reliability during executive demos. Suggest scheduling a 24h warm window before a renewal call. Also: a short FAQ bullet on "why latency dropped after idle".

nina_research: For the ops examples, here's a tiny prefill snippet we've used in CS pilots:
```bash
# prefill 3 prompts, low priority, low concurrency
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/prefill \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -d '{"prompts": ["Welcome back","Confirm access","Context: user prefs"], "priority": "low", "concurrency": 1}'
```
Notes: prefer short prompts (10-40 tokens), run ~5-10 minutes before demo for tiny accounts.

aj_support: Also include a fallback policy snippet customers can copy to reduce token cost if prefill isn't possible. Example: set batch_window_ms=25 and max_batch_tokens=512 for demo routes.

maria_cs: Good call. I'll add a tiny table of recommended batch settings by expected QPS.

nina_research: Quick perf thresholds (for us to share):
- Cold start 99p tail: 400–800ms for small models, 800–1500ms for medium models (on dedicated infra)
- After prefill (warm): 60–200ms p50 for small workloads
Add a note: observed higher variance for multi-tenant demo accounts — recommend dedicated warm window.

devon_psm: Can we add a short script for automated prefill via our support tooling? If yes, CS can run it on customer's behalf before renewal meeting.

maria_cs: Yes — ops_bot can trigger runbook jobs. @ops_bot can you add a template job name we can call?

ops_bot: runbook_job_template:cs-prefill-demo-v1 created and available in Console -> Runbook Jobs. Use tag `cs-prefill:<account-id>` to schedule. Logs will be emitted to /console/logs/runbook. :white_check_mark:

aj_support: One more: include a short "what to ask the customer" checklist (network egress rules, API key rotation timing, expected concurrent users during demo). Keeps postmortems shorter.

maria_cs: Perfect. I'll turn this into a one-page PDF + inline email snippet. Draft will be here: https://docs.redwood/inference/cs/prefill-runbook (internal). Planning to ship to CS templates folder after review. Anything else?

devon_psm: Looks good. Maybe a short renewal play: schedule prefill 24h, quick smoke 30m before, enable live streaming for exec Q&A. Add a single line about cost expectations.

maria_cs: Done. I'll update the draft and ping reviewers. Thanks all :sparkles:
